title: 第11章 夸张身材的隐患第12章 以貌取人
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
元红鸾一张俏脸涨得通红，她当然能判断出对方不是故意的，是因为自己拖拽他的力过大了些，本来因为之前的事生气想让他出个丑，万万没想到他反应竟然如此之快。
关键是对方确实只抱了自己腰，但接触的一瞬间难免蹭到一些不该蹭的地方，谁让她天赋如此异禀？
当真是搬起石头砸自己的脚！
冰坨子果然天生跟我八字不合，连她的未婚夫竟然都这样气人！
对面的劲装少女忍不住歪了歪头，这两个人是在这里打情骂俏么？
她实在不能理解有人会在生死相搏时分这样大的心，所以她并没有浪费这个机会，足尖一点，身体螺旋前飞，手中的剑随着震颤化作了密密麻麻的剑影。
宋牧驰穿越前经常在武侠小说里听到暴雨梨花针，他从来没见过暴雨梨花针是怎么样的，但此时对方的剑法给他的感觉就是犹如暴雨一般迎面而来，根本无处躲避。
元红鸾却是轻哼一声，从腰间抽出一柄弯刀，随意一刀朝前劈了过去。
比起对面骇然的声势，她这一刀可谓朴实无华。
可就是这样一刀，却劈开了风暴，万千剑影遇之纷纷消融。
叮！
一道清脆的刀剑交接声音响起，劲装少女呆立当场，只见虎口的一道血痕，刚刚手中的剑竟然已经被击飞到远处，插在地上犹自震颤。
“剑法不错！你这家伙不是自诩情圣，最擅长对付女人么，怎么人家还要对你喊打喊杀的。”元红鸾前半句是对劲装少女说的，后半句则是回头望着宋牧驰，脸上尽是戏谑的笑意。
宋牧驰叹了一口气“如果有哪个男人说他最擅长对付女人，那么他一定不懂女人。”
看着他近在咫尺的俊脸，元红鸾有些牙痒痒，那么多花魁对他死心塌地，他还说不懂女人？
这时对面的劲装少女再次动了，剑没了还有手，以前师父教过她，天下万物皆可为剑。
对方虽然修为高过自己，但三番五次分神，自己还是有机会完成夫人的命令。
刚刚手下留情对方竟然还要冲过来，元红鸾脸色一冷“找死！”
旋即一刀挥出，一道肉眼可见的刀气迎了上去，刀气所过之处，连空气仿佛都被挤压到了两旁。
劲装少女神情一呆，看到那迎面而来的刀气，她意识到自己挡不住。

马上就要死了，不过好像也没什么大不了的。
就在这时，一道白色的身影从马车中冲了出来，瞬间来到她身前，手中挥舞着一条白色绸带。
绸带仿佛没有半分重量，柔--软到了极致，化作了一道道圆圈。
可迎面而来的刚猛刀气竟然无法砍断这脆弱的绸带，被那一道道圆圈缠绕，渐渐消融不见。
元红鸾咦了一声，有些意外地打量着眼前的白衣女子，好一个端庄优雅的未亡人。
不错，这是她看到对方第一眼产生的印象。
跟少女的装扮不同，对面女子的衣裙更加修身，将女人婀娜曼妙的线条完美地展现了出来。
略微紧身的上衣，越发凸显胸怀的温柔与包容；
盈盈一握的腰肢，让腰-臀-比显得惊心动魄。
也许是察觉到这一身太贴身了，所以她裙子外面披着一件蓝色大衣，仿佛披风一般，前面的扣子扣得整整齐齐，一定程度上遮掩住了她那傲人的曲线。
可越是这样若隐若现，越是诱人。
正是因为这份保守，让明明妩媚到极点的她整体的气质反而更偏向于优雅端庄。
对方明明梳着已婚的发髻，但浑身上下并没有正常的已婚妇人那般精心打扮。
不仅不施粉黛，甚至连衣裳的颜色也十分素净。
世上一般只有死了丈夫的未亡人才会这般打扮。
几缕发丝被寒风吹得飘散在脸颊，给她增加了几分破碎感，再加上对方那平静温和的眼神，会让看到她的人下意识觉得“错的绝对不是她”。
只是一个照面，元红鸾就有些羡慕，对方身上那种特殊的风韵是青涩少女难以企及的。
她打量对方的时候，对方同样也在打量她，心想好娇艳的小姑娘！
当她目光落到对方胸口的时候，神色不禁一凝，这小姑娘明明这么年轻，到底吃什么长大的？
眼神短暂接触过后，那位夫人朱唇轻启“小姑娘年纪轻轻，就下这么毒的手，恐怕不太好吧。”

元红鸾翻了个白眼“这一地的死尸，到底是谁的手更毒啊。”
夫人神色平静“他们自己心存不轨，如果我们是手无缚缚鸡之力的女子，如今的下场恐怕凄惨无比。他们技不如人，自然是死有余辜。”
content_en:
Yuan Hongluan's pretty face turned red. Of course she could tell that the other party didn't mean it, it was because she dragged him too hard. She was originally angry because of the previous incident and wanted to make him look embarrassed, but she never expected that he would react so quickly.
The key is that the other party did only hug her waist, but the moment of contact, she inevitably rubbed some places that she shouldn't have touched. Who made her so talented?
You really shot yourself in the foot!
Bingtuozi is indeed not compatible with me, and even her fiancé is so irritating!
The well-dressed girl opposite couldn't help but tilt her head. Are these two people flirting here?
She really couldn't understand how someone would have such a big heart in a life-and-death fight, so she didn't waste this opportunity. Pointing her toes, her body spiraled forward, and the sword in her hand trembled and turned into dense sword shadows.
Before Song Muchi traveled through time, he often heard about Rainstorm Pear Blossom Needle in martial arts novels. He had never seen what Rainstorm Pear Blossom Needle looked like, but at this time, the opponent's swordsmanship gave him the feeling that it was like a rainstorm coming towards him, with no way to escape.
Yuan Hongluan snorted softly, took out a scimitar from his waist, and slashed forward with a casual slash.
Compared to the horrifying momentum on the other side, her sword was simple and unpretentious.
But just such a sword split the storm, and thousands of sword shadows melted one after another.
bite!
A crisp sound of sword handover sounded, and the girl in the costume stood stunned on the spot, only to see a trace of blood on the tiger's mouth. The sword in her hand had been knocked far away, and it was still trembling when it was stuck on the ground.
"Your swordsmanship is good! Don't you call yourself a love saint and the best at dealing with women? Why do people still yell at you to kill you?" Yuan Hongluan said the first half of the sentence to the girl in disguise, and the second half of the sentence turned back to look at Song Muchi, with a joking smile on his face.
Song Muchi sighed, "If any man says he is best at dealing with women, then he must not understand women."
Looking at his handsome face so close, Yuan Hongluan felt a little itchy. So many courtesans were devoted to him, but he still said he didn't understand women?
At this time, the well-dressed girl opposite moved again. The sword was gone but she still had her hand. Her master had taught her before that everything in the world could be used as a sword.
Although the other party's cultivation level was higher than mine, he still had a chance to complete his wife's order despite being distracted time and time again.
The opponent who showed mercy just now actually rushed over. Yuan Hongluan's face turned cold and he said, "Looking for death!"
Immediately, the sword was swung out, and a sword energy visible to the naked eye came forward. Wherever the sword energy passed, even the air seemed to be squeezed to both sides.
The well-dressed girl was stunned. When she saw the oncoming sword energy, she realized that she couldn't stop it.
He's going to die soon, but it doesn't seem to be a big deal.
At this moment, a white figure rushed out of the carriage and came to her in an instant, waving a white ribbon in his hand.
The ribbon seemed to have no weight at all, and was soft to the extreme, turning into circles.
But the fierce sword energy coming towards him was unable to cut through the fragile ribbon, and it was entangled in circles and gradually disappeared.
Yuan Hongluan let out a sigh and looked at the woman in white in surprise, she was such a dignified and elegant widow.
Yes, this was the first impression she had when she saw him.
Different from the girl's dress, the woman's dress opposite is more slim-fitting, perfectly showing off the woman's graceful lines.
The slightly tight top highlights the gentleness and tolerance of the chest;
The slim waist makes the waist-to-hip ratio look thrilling.
Perhaps she realized that this outfit was too close-fitting, so she wore a blue coat outside her skirt like a cloak. The buttons in the front were neatly buttoned, which covered her proud curves to a certain extent.
But the more looming it is, the more tempting it is.
It is precisely because of this conservatism that her overall temperament, which is obviously extremely charming, becomes even more...Prefer elegance and dignity.
The other party obviously wore her hair in a married bun, but her whole body was not as carefully dressed as a normal married woman.
Not only is there no makeup, even the color of the clothes is very plain.
In this world, only the survivors of their husbands would dress up like this.
A few strands of hair were blown around her face by the cold wind, adding a sense of fragmentation to her. Coupled with the calm and gentle eyes of the other party, those who saw her would subconsciously feel that "it was definitely not her who was at fault."
Just meeting each other made Yuan Hongluan feel a little envious. The special charm of the other party was difficult for young girls to match.
When she looked at the other person, the other person was also looking at her, thinking what a pretty little girl!
When her eyes fell on the other person's chest, her expression couldn't help but condense. This little girl was obviously so young. What did she eat when she grew up?
After a brief eye contact, the lady's red lips opened slightly: "I'm afraid it's not good for the little girl to do such a cruel thing at such a young age."
Yuan Hongluan rolled his eyes, "Among the dead bodies here, whose hands are more poisonous?"
The madam looked calm, "They have evil intentions. If we were women without the power to restrain a chicken, our current fate would be extremely miserable. Their skills are inferior to others, so they will naturally die unjustly."
